title: Capacity Steering: Throughput SLO Policy Sandbox & Autoscale Simulator
creator: Sofia Li
description: Build an interactive policy sandbox in the Console that lets ops engineers author, validate, and preview throughput SLOs and autoscaling policies for Dedicated fleets. The sandbox should include: 1) a policy editor with typed presets (SLO target, min/max nodes, warmup, cooldown, burst allowance), 2) a simulator that replays historical traffic to show projected node/throughput curves and cost delta, 3) a preview pane that shows expected fallback behavior under capacity pressure (model fallback, region failover, degraded QoS), and 4) a change preview which can be applied as a canary or rolled out fleet-wide. This ticket covers PM design, acceptance criteria, and coordination with ENG/DES for the initial MVP.
notes: 2026-02-15: Kickoff — aligned on scope: editor + simulator + change preview. MVP excludes live rollout orchestration (handled by ENG-5342).
2026-02-22: Design deep-dive with DES. Decided on a 3-pane layout: policy form, simulator timeline, cost/impact summary. Design will provide accessible components for compact and expanded views.

2026-02-28: Eng scoping (ENG-5201, ENG-5342). Backend needs new /policy/simulate API that replays 30 days of traffic; agreed on offline simulation first (sync job) and streaming simulation in later iteration.
2026-03-05: Trade-offs: simulator accuracy vs cost. Decided to use sampled trace replay (1% sample) for fast iteration; full-fidelity replay will be optional scheduled job due to compute cost.

2026-03-09: QA criteria added — simulator must converge within 5% of historical node-hours on validated workloads; cost delta shown as absolute and percent change; safety presets must not reduce min_nodes below existing committed capacity.
2026-03-12: Integration tests passing for policy form + simulation API. Interrupted by a blocker: permissions model for preview must respect role-based limits (see DES-88).

acceptance_criteria: Policy editor: create, edit, and save throughput SLO policies with preset templates and freeform mode.
Simulator: run a 30-day historical replay (sampled) and produce node-count timeline, expected throughput headroom, and cost delta within 5% of historical node-hours.
Change preview: show deterministic fallback behavior for capacity shortfalls, including model variant fallback and region failover descriptions.
Apply flow: user can apply change as 'preview-only', 'canary (10%)', or 'rollout'. Canary must create a traceable change set with audit metadata.
Role enforcement: only users with 'fleet-admin' can apply policy changes; preview allowed for 'fleet-viewer'.
Telemetry: events emitted for simulation runs, policy saves, and apply actions with correlation IDs.
Docs: brief Console help panel and a linked runbook for interpreting simulator outputs.
